target.artifact: portfolio dedupe-key exclusive claim fence and durable collision receipt
target.consumer: fresh /wc portfolio fallback allocator and future portfolio stress verifier

title: Fence concurrent portfolio claims by dedupe_key
problem: The portfolio worker contract says a non-expired active claim for a dedupe_key blocks duplicate execution, but the prescribed atomic CREATE target is coordination/portfolio/claims/<job_id>/<unique claim_id>.json. Different contenders therefore create different paths and cannot collide at the storage primitive. Live evidence on 2026-09-17 produced at least two Alumnos claims two seconds apart for the same job/dedupe_key; this worker began read-only archaeology before the earlier claim became visible, then yielded and persisted a BOUNDARY return. Additional same-job claims appeared seconds later. The current mechanism preserves history but does not elect exactly one substantive portfolio writer.
mission: Introduce a shared, reconstructable exclusivity fence for each live portfolio dedupe_key/lease generation while preserving append-only claim history. Losing workers must detect or lose the fence before substantive target work, persist durable collision/boundary evidence linked to the winner, and immediately re-enter allocation.
acceptance: For one portfolio dedupe_key and overlapping substantive scope, at most one worker obtains execution authority in a live lease generation.

The exclusivity decision is atomic create-if-absent/CAS or an equivalent deterministic election over a shared fence identity; unique claim_id files remain evidence only and are not treated as the lock.

A loser that already created its immutable claim record yields before substantive target writes, records a durable collision/boundary receipt with the winning fence/claim reference, and re-enters allocation.
Historical claims and returns are never overwritten or deleted, and late returns remain reconcilable.
Different dedupe_keys retain parallelism; the fix must not serialize the whole portfolio.
Lease expiry/recovery semantics remain explicit so an abandoned winner cannot block a job forever.
A deterministic two-or-more-worker fixture and a live fresh-/wc canary both demonstrate exactly one substantive winner for the same portfolio dedupe_key.
The portfolio Live projection can distinguish contention/loser boundaries from successful job completion without treating BOUNDARY as terminal.

observed_live_evidence.finding: Both claim CREATE operations succeeded because they targeted different claim_id paths. The later worker had to reconstruct winner ordering after the fact rather than losing atomically at claim time.

value_signals.unblock_value: Makes portfolio fallback safe under the exact many-identical-fresh-chat launch pattern it was introduced to serve.
value_signals.compounding_value: As portfolio successors begin generating more jobs, contention rises; a per-dedupe fence prevents extra capacity from turning into duplicate work.
value_signals.human_friction_reduction: Workers can resolve portfolio races without the human choosing which duplicate chat continues.
value_signals.information_gain: Durable winner/loser receipts make portfolio contention measurable instead of inferred from duplicate claim directories.

risk.main: A broad lock could serialize unrelated portfolio work or leave stale fences behind.
risk.mitigation: Fence only one dedupe_key/lease generation; preserve unique claim files as append-only evidence; define expiry/recovery explicitly and prove unrelated dedupe_keys remain parallel.

falsification: Two concurrent workers for the same portfolio dedupe_key can both obtain substantive execution authority.
The mechanism relies on later timestamp comparison as authority rather than atomic/deterministic election.
A loser cannot durably identify the winning fence/claim it yielded to.
A stale winner blocks the job indefinitely with no lease recovery path.
Claims for different dedupe_keys are serialized by the fix.
A BOUNDARY loser is incorrectly rendered as terminal completion of the portfolio job.
dedup_note: Not a duplicate of P-04df793d0713-e1aaac9c, which instruments ordinary live claim-attempt outcomes, nor P-1c64c0e1e704-recovery-race-v1, which fences recovery generations. This proposal targets the newly introduced portfolio fallback contract whose unique per-claim paths make create-if-absent incapable of dedupe-key arbitration by construction.

source_freshness.note: Live claim commits were observed directly from main during the fresh-/wc burst.
